title: Sub-Randers metrics
summary: We introduce a new class of sub-Finsler metrics, called sub-Randers metrics, obtained by adding a one-form $β\in Γ(\mathcal{D}^*)$ to a sub-Riemannian metric $a$ on a bracket-generating distribution $\mathcal{D} \subset TM$. We define a sub-Randers manifold as a triple $(M, \mathcal{D}, F)$, where $M$ is an $n$-dimensional smooth manifold and $F(v) = \sqrt{a(v,v)} + β(v)$, the condition $\|β\|_a < 1$ ensures positive definiteness and convexity.
